recipes.name: Pizza Ball inspired by The Eric Andre Show
ingredients: Prepared Pizza Dough (homemade or store bought)
Parmesan Cheese (the powdered kind the jar)
instructions: Start by rolling out your pizza dough on a liberally floured work surface. Cut into 1 inch squares. - Flour (for work surface) - Prepared Pizza Dough (homemade or store bought)

Add some pepperoni and one cube of mozzarella cheese to the square of dough. Wrap each corner up and around the mozzarella clockwise, being sure to pinch all gaps closed. - Pepperoni - Mozzarella Cheese cubed
In a cast iron skillet, heat 1 inch of vegetable oil to 350°F and add your pizza balls. Flip and fry for about 5 minutes until they are deeply golden brown. - Vegetable Oil
In a separate bowl combine: parmesan cheese, a few healthy dashes of oregano, and red pepper flakes. - Parmesan Cheese (the powdered kind the jar) - Oregano - Red Pepper Flakes
Remove pizza balls from the cast iron and toss them in the parmesan mixture.
Serve with a side of warm marinara sauce and enjoy! - Marinara Sauce
